_doc: Independent checklists used by the presence rule (tools/presence.py, AGENTS.md rule 6g): a species with at least one Research Grade iNaturalist observation in the Philippines counts as confirmed there when its checklist lists it for the Philippines. A checklist alone never confirms a species nobody observed. Derived lists only (names), fetched 2026-11-04; refresh by hand from the sources named in each part.

fishbase.src: FishBase, country checklist of the Philippines (c_code 608, all habitats), Table 1: species currently present (endemic, native, introduced)

cotw.src: Corals of the World (Veron, Stafford-Smith, Turak and DeVantier), ecoregion species lists (confirmed and strongly predicted; the site does not separate them) of the four ecoregions that cover the Philippines. Sulu Sea and Celebes Sea also reach Malaysia and Indonesia. Names as COTW writes them (pre-2014 genera), each with its WoRMS accepted name(s) when different

decided.Plesiastrea versipora: Mapped to P. peroni by decision, not by WoRMS (which keeps P. versipora for the temperate populations): Juszkiewicz et al. 2022 revived P. peroni for the tropical ones, so the Philippine lists' P. versipora is P. peroni (Pierre, 2026-11-05, Q50; docs/reviews/2026-11-05-coral-taxonomy-study.md)
